Problem Statement:
You are given an N by N matrix M. M[i, j] = '.', means that there is a plant at that cell and M[i, j] = '#' means that there is a weed at that cell. Find the number of plants and weeds on the boundary of the Matrix. 
Input Description:
The first line contains an integer N denoting the matrix dimension Then read an N x N matrix 
Output Description:
Print two space separated integers denoting the number of plants and the number of weeds respectively. 
Explanation:
Self explanatory 
Sample Input:
5
#.###
.#...
.##..
.....
....# 
Sample Output:
11 5
